dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary macro-annuli exhibit complex, serrated perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark exterior pixels to lighter interior regions, forming irregular 'O' and 'C' shapes across the mid-dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of high-intensity pixels are densely packed along the borders of the annular patterns, while solid low-intensity pixels are concentrated in the cores of the largest circular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral along the animal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, linear green environmental object is draped across the ventrolateral neck region; prominent dark claws are clearly visible on the extended pectoral flipper.
